Post Record.description: Sends a JSON record to the API with the adaptor's authenticated POST helper.

Check API Connectivity.description: Calls the health probe to confirm the credential and network path work.
Check API Connectivity.code:
// Confirm the API is reachable and the token is accepted.
http.request('GET', '/ping');

List Records.description: Reads a list of records with the generic authenticated request helper.

Get Record By ID.description: Fetches a single record by its id.
Get Record By ID.code:
// GET one record by id.
http.request('GET', `/records/${$.data.recordId}`);
